title: Official Metadata Addon Provider Architecture Deepening
problem: Provider extension remains too shallow across config, registry, manifest, search policy, diagnostics, and browser-worker support semantics.

evidence.summary: Workstream opened from architecture review and user-approved five-refactor Goal.
Provider catalog entries now own default enablement, enablement env vars, provider config loading, and provider-local proxy facts.
ProviderRegistry now exposes one ProviderAssembly for ready adapters, diagnostics, and provider-owned network policy facts consumed by routes.
TMDB and Bangumi now share a provider-private search policy module for direct lookup, title-variant search, dedupe, ranking-budget selection, partial-search preservation, and degraded fallback.
Provider diagnostics now flow through typed ProviderOutcome facts rendered by one redaction-safe engine outcome module while preserving the public provider_note payload field.

Browser-worker protocol handling now lives in a rendered-page support runtime; Douban consumes it as infrastructure while browser_worker remains a default-off provider for explicit rendered-page URL extraction.
Full nako-metadata-scraper package validation passed after all five provider architecture refactors; public docs already covered the unchanged provider strategy.

continue_policy.notes: Continue through OMAPAD-020, OMAPAD-030, OMAPAD-040, OMAPAD-050, and OMAPAD-060 while public payload compatibility remains valid. Split follow-ons if a task changes Addon Protocol or Nako host contracts.
